desc:
Welcome to Build an Anime Girl! 

🪑 Grab a seat at a table and challenge a friend or a rival in 1v1 or 4-player matches!
🎴 Every round a new character appears, so place her in Hair, Face, Voice, Personality or Style!
🧠 Her stats are hidden, so pick the right slot and build the ultimate anime girl!
💥 Watch the SHOWDOWN as your picks fight it out, one category at a time!
💎 Pull rare characters, from Legendary and Mythic all the way to the GOD tier!
🏆 Win matches, earn cash, keep your streak alive and top the leaderboard!

⭐Please like and favorite the game if you enjoy it!

🔥Update: Gamemode + New characters!🔥
